svg.text: Rung 7, Atom Builders: inside the chloroplast
Atoms are things you hold; none can be made or thrown away; energy is gold and ends as warmth
Most of the air is nitrogen (blue-grey pairs);
the green sails (thylakoids) catch the light
each carbon comes from one CO2 and links
with gold hydrogen; one O2 leaves each time
the chain curls into a ring: glucose
(5 carbons and 1 oxygen; the 6th carbon on its arm)
The balance stays level: every atom is still there.
The light's energy is in the ring (gold), never an atom.
